name: Kasaragod
tagline: Kerala's northern frontier of forts and many languages
summary: Kasaragod: Bekal Fort, Ananthapura Lake Temple, Yakshagana, Tulu and Kannada influences and quiet northern beaches.

history.overview: Kasaragod lies between Malayalam, Tulu and Kannada cultures. Bekal Fort, built in the 17th century by the Keladi Nayakas, is one of Kerala's largest forts.

timeline.event: Bekal Fort is built by the Keladi Nayakas.
Joins Kerala in the state reorganisation.

unique: Multilingual culture of Malayalam, Tulu, Kannada and Konkani

bestTime.why: Pleasant weather for forts and beaches.
